about: Solid sample preparation: method, intensity, set-temp, program, start (job), pause, stop, rearm, result, and for the manual press pump, valve, leadscrew and the guards; status. Ranges, enums and units come from each contract; method templates are the contracts' reference arguments.

excluded.ika_t25: the disperser homogenises a liquid suspension (wet dispersion); its verbs (speed, start/stop) are the agitation class's, which owns it as primary; a solid_prep secondary would add no verb it lacks there.

method.fix: wait for the job, or stop it.

method.message: {inst} still holds the last cycle ({value} s ground); a new method is set after re-arming.
method.fix: `chemlab run {inst} rearm`, then set the method.

intensity.fix: wait for the job, or stop it.

intensity.message: {inst} still holds the last cycle; the speed is set after re-arming.
intensity.fix: `chemlab run {inst} rearm`, then set the speed.

start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: the lid of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid`.

start.message: the lid of {inst} is still closing ({value} rad).
start.fix: wait a few seconds (`chemlab wait 5`) and start again.

start.message: no grinding jar with sample is in {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to load the jar.

start.message: the grinding jar in {inst} is not clamped.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to clamp it.

start.message: the counterweight of {inst} is not set for the jar.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to balance it.

start.message: {inst} has no grinding parameters set.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} method speed=300rpm time=5min`.

start.message: the last cycle of {inst} has ended ({value}).
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} rearm`, then start.

start.message: {inst} is already grinding.
start.fix: wait for the job, or stop it.

rearm.message: {inst} has no finished or stopped cycle ({value}).

program.fix: wait for the job, or stop it.

unsupported.set-temp: the mill has no heating or cooling (the jar warms by grinding)
unsupported.pause: the PM 100 has Start and Stop only; a stopped cycle resumes with `start`
unsupported.feeder: no vibratory feeder (the jar is filled by hand)

alternatives.pause: stop it (`chemlab run INST stop`) and resume with `chemlab run INST start` (the remaining time is kept).

start: --delay T uses the start-delay function of the mill (acquisition.start_in)
intensity: the mill speed (milling.set_speed) before the cycle starts

method.message: {inst} still holds the last sieving ({value} s); a new method is set after re-arming.
method.fix: `chemlab run {inst} rearm`, then set the method.

start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: no sieve stack with sample is on {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to load it.

start.message: the clamping cover of {inst} is not down.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close cover`; the operator then clamps the stack.

start.message: the cover of {inst} is still coming down ({value} m).
start.fix: wait a few seconds (`chemlab wait 5`) and start again.

start.message: the sieve stack on {inst} is not clamped.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to clamp it.

start.message: {inst} has no sieving parameters set.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} method amplitude=1.2mm time=5min`.

start.message: the last sieving of {inst} has ended ({value}).
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} rearm`, then start.

rearm.message: {inst} has no finished or stopped cycle ({value}).

program.fix: wait for the job, or stop it.

unsupported.set-temp: the sieve shaker has no heating
unsupported.feeder: no vibratory feeder (the top sieve is filled by hand)

method: time= in whole minutes (the AS 200 counts minutes); amplitude= is the total lift (peak to peak), 0.2 to 3 mm
intensity: the sieving amplitude (sieving.set_lift), also while sieving

method.message: {inst} has already divided this sample ({value} s); the method is set before the run.
method.fix: ask the lab operator for the next sample.

start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: {inst} has no run time and feeder intensity set.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} method time=1min intensity=60`.

start.message: the hopper of {inst} is empty.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to fill it.

start.message: not all sample bottles are attached to {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to attach them.

start.message: the vibratory feeder of {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} feeder on`.

start.message: the hopper gap of {inst} is still moving ({value} m).
start.fix: wait a moment (`chemlab wait 3`) and start again.

start.message: {inst} has already run on this sample ({value}).
start.fix: ask the lab operator for the next sample.

unsupported.program: the PT 100 has no program memory (time and feed intensity only)
unsupported.rearm: one run per loaded sample: the operator empties the bottles and refills the hopper for the next one

method: time= takes the PT 100 timer steps (1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 30 ... min); gap= sets the hopper gap (at least 3 x the largest grain)

pump.fix: ask the lab operator to put the die in.
ask the lab operator to fill it.

pump.message: the front guard of {inst} is not down ({value} m).
the rear guard of {inst} is not down ({value} m).
the release valve of {inst} is open, so the pump cannot build pressure.
the press cycle of {inst} has ended ({value}).
pump.fix: release the load (`chemlab run {inst} valve open`).

start.message: no die is in {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to put the die in.

start.message: the die in {inst} is empty.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to fill it.

start.message: {inst} has no target load set.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} method load=68kN hold=2min`.

start.message: the front guard of {inst} is not down ({value} m).
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} close guard`.

start.message: the rear guard of {inst} is not down ({value} m).
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} close rear-guard`.

start.message: the release valve of {inst} is open.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} valve close`.

start.message: {inst} has already pressed this sample ({value}).
start.fix: release the load and ask the operator for the next die fill.

open:guard.message: {inst} is under load ({value} N); the guard stays down.
a press cycle of {inst} is running; the guard stays down.
open:guard.fix: release the load (`valve open`) and stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`) first.

open:rear-guard.message: {inst} is under load ({value} N); the guard stays down.
a press cycle of {inst} is running; the guard stays down.
open:rear-guard.fix: release the load (`valve open`) and stop it (`chemlab run {inst} stop`) first.

leadscrew.message: a press cycle of {inst} is running; the leadscrew is set before `start`.
leadscrew.fix: release the load (`valve open`), `stop`, and set the leadscrew before the next cycle.

leadscrew.message: the ram of {inst} is not down.
leadscrew.fix: open the valve and let it return (`chemlab run {inst} valve open`).

PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused ({cap}); a check the class could not see failed (load above the relief limit, the die stack does not fit, or the pump still moving).
PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status` (limit >= method load; leadscrew position).

unsupported.intensity: a manual press has no speed or amplitude: the load is pumped up to the method load (`pump --to LOAD`)
unsupported.set-temp: the Atlas Manual press has no heated platens here
unsupported.program: a manual press has no program memory
unsupported.pause: the hold cannot be paused; release the load with `valve open`
unsupported.rearm: one press cycle per die fill: the operator ejects the pellet and refills the die

start: start begins the observed press cycle; the load is then pumped by hand (`pump --to LOAD --hold`) and held for the method hold time
pump: each stroke takes about 0.8 s; --hold keeps topping the load up while the compacting powder relaxes, until the cycle is complete
method: limit= sets the relief-valve load limit (relief.set_limit); it must be at least the target load

method.message: {inst} is in a fusion cycle ({value}); the method is set before the start.

set-temp.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: no crucible with sample and flux is in {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to load it.

start.message: {inst} has no fusion method set.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} method segments=10min@1065C,9min@1065C` (or load a program).

start.message: the door of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close door`.

start.message: the door of {inst} is still closing ({value} rad).
start.fix: wait a few seconds (`chemlab wait 5`) and start again.

start.message: {inst} has already fused this sample ({value}).
start.fix: ask the lab operator to take the bead out and load the next crucible.

unsupported.intensity: the rocking of the crucible is part of the fusion method (`method rocking=10deg rocking-freq=0.3Hz`)
unsupported.pause: a fusion cycle cannot be paused (the melt would set in the crucible)
unsupported.rearm: one fusion cycle per loaded crucible: the operator takes the bead out and loads the next one
unsupported.feeder: no feeder (crucibles are loaded by hand)

alternatives.intensity: set the rocking in the method: `chemlab run malvern_leneo method rocking=10deg rocking-freq=0.3Hz`.

set-temp: the furnace idle / preheat set point; the fusion cycle itself follows the method segments
method: segments=TIME@TEMP,... is the heating programme (each segment ends at TEMP after TIME); the four pouring profiles come from the template
